issues.claim: "Outside 9-6 weekdays nothing answers: calls go to voicemail, email waits until the next business day." (Section 2, Impact)
issues.problem: Stated as fact but unsupported: no source says what happens to calls after hours. Published hours (Mon-Fri 9-6, weekends closed) and the absence of a published after-hours route only support a likelihood, not that the line goes to voicemail or when email is read. The '(our inference)' label is attached to the preceding sentence only, so this reads as an observed fact about the owner's phone system - and it is the very thing the paid pilot is sold on.
issues.fix: Either label it, e.g. "Outside 9-6 weekdays the published route is silent, so an unanswered call most likely goes to voicemail and an email waits for the next business day (our inference)", or drop the voicemail claim and say only that no after-hours route is published.

issues.claim: "Dropped: Birdeye (page returned HTTP 404 on verification, so hours are cited to Nextdoor)." (Sources note)
issues.problem: The Birdeye profile URL loads normally now (HTTP 200), shows 'This profile has not been claimed', 4.2 / 28 reviews and the same hours (Mon-Fri 9:00 a.m.-6:00 p.m., Sat/Sun closed). The 404 was likely transient or a bad fetch, so the note misdescribes the source state; the underlying hours claim is unaffected.
issues.fix: Re-check the URL and, if it loads, cite Birdeye alongside Nextdoor as the second corroborating source for hours; if you want to keep the note, phrase it as 'returned 404 at the time of checking' and note it was reachable on review.
